title: 고등법원 부의 지방법원 소재지에서의 사무처리에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:9:0:00009:part:1/1
title_original: 고등법원 부의 지방법원 소재지에서의 사무처리에 관한 규칙
full_text: Article 9 (Case Numbers) Where a case is received under Article 8 (1), the geographical designation portion of the name of the District Court at the seat of the outlying division shall be placed in parentheses before the case number prescribed in Article 19 (2) of the Rules on Court Trial Affairs, and a progress number shall be assigned independently from progress numbers of cases received by the relevant High Court. <Amended on April 30, 2005; February 20, 2008>
